name: Enchanted Bolts raises Magic damage by 5% and armor penetration by 10% (#1955)
contract: Enchanted Bolts 520548 has E0 aura 79 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE), MiscValue 126 (all magic schools), BasePoints 4 / DieSides 1 = +5%, and E1 aura 280 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT), MiscValue 0 with no class mask, BasePoints 9 / DieSides 1 = +10%; the description reads 'Increases your Magic damage dealt by $s1% and your Armor penetration by $s2%' (the issue mislabels aura 79 as a school immunity). Aura 79 is read by school mask in Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone and Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone, so Tormentor 501355's direct effect 2 (school damage, Shadow 0x20) gains exactly 5% while Darkslayer 804179 (Physical, 0x1) does not. Unit::CalcArmorReducedDamage accepts aura 280 with MiscValue 0 and an empty class mask for every attack and ignores 10% of the capped armor, so Darkslayer lets more of a 1000 hit through a target that has armor; the exact figure depends on the creature's armor, so the scenario asserts a fixture (armor > 0 and the probe mitigated) and an increase, the shape used by the Barely Human scenario. CORRECTION from slot 3 measurements: the first version probed Shadow Rage 567570, which read 1000 both with and without the talent (aura amounts 5 and 10 present). That is by design, not a defect of the passive: Shadow Rage is a copy-damage helper that AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:308-313 marks SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone returns the raw amount for it, Unit.cpp:9176), because the amount it deals is taken from a hit that already carried the modifiers. Tormentor 501355 (Shadow, no such attribute) read 1000 without and 1050 with the talent for both its direct effect 2 and its periodic effect 0, so effect 2 is the probe now. The scenario also waits 1.5 s after the learn before comparing.
